items.title: 9.2 Cybersecurity ka shaoor aur khatron ka intizam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 9.2 (PDF 125-128), paragraph for paragraph; the threat, security-tool, 2FA and encryption figures, self-check and recap are ours.

blocks.text: Cybersecurity awareness (shaoor) ka matlab hai yeh samajhna ke computers, networks aur data ko hamlon (attacks) se kaise bachaya jaye. Jaise jaise log technology par zyada inhisar karte hain, rozmarra zindagi mein cyber threats aam ho gaye hain. Hackers maloomat churane ya systems kharab karne ke liye chalakiyan aur nuqsan-deh software use karte hain. In khatron se waqif hona users ko hoshyar rakhta hai aur woh online mehfooz tareeqe se kaam karte hain. Khatron ko pehchanna (detect), rokna (prevent) aur un ka jawab dena (respond) zaati aur idaron (organizations) ka data mehfooz rakhta hai. Misal: users ko apne computer malware aur doosre khatron se bachane ke liye antivirus software install karna chahiye. Online banking ya doosre hassas (sensitive) kaam ke liye public Wi-Fi se bhi bachna chahiye kyunke public networks mehfooz nahi bhi ho sakte.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Gandi (offensive) zaban, spam aur raaz wali (confidential) maloomat share karne se bachein.
Cyber threats ko samajhna

Cyber threats aise kaam ya programs hain jo nuqsan pohanchane ke liye computers aur networks ko nishana banate hain. In mein maloomat churana, systems kharab karna ya online services rokna shamil hai. Yeh samajhna ke khatre kaise kaam karte hain, users ko shuru ke khatre ke nishan pehchanne mein madad deta hai. Zyada tar hamlon se mehfooz browsing, antivirus software aur emails aur links mein ehtiyat se bacha ja sakta hai. Khatron ko pehchanna digital systems ki hifazat ki taraf pehla qadam hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Phishing sab se aam hamlon mein se ek hai.
Cyberattacks ki aam qismein

Cyber threats ki mukhtalif qismein hain. Virus infected (bimar) files ke zariye phailta hai aur data kharab ya delete kar sakta hai. Phishing jaali emails ya websites ke zariye logon ko dhoka de kar un se passwords ya zaati tafseel lene ki koshish karti hai. Ransomware data ko lock kar deta hai aur kholne ke liye paisa (payment) mangta hai, jab ke spyware chupke se user ki maloomat jama karta hai. Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) hamle websites par itna bojh (traffic) dalte hain ke woh crash ho jati hain.

blocks.alt: Paanch cards: Virus (mutasira files se phail kar data kharab), Phishing (jaali email ya website se password ki chori), Ransomware (data band, paisay ki maang), Spyware (chupke se maloomat jama), DDoS (website par itna bojh ke crash). Neeche 'Nuqsan kis ko?': afraad files, passwords ya paisa kho sakte; idaron ko data breach, rukay kaam, bharosa, saakh aur maali nuqsan.
blocks.caption: Cyber hamlon ki paanch qismein aur un ka nuqsan (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.text: Cyberattacks afraad aur idaron par kaise asar dalte hain

Cyberattacks afraad (individuals) aur idaron (organizations) dono ko sakht nuqsan pohancha sakte hain. Log apni zaati files, passwords ya paisa kho sakte hain, jab ke companies ko data breach aur customers ka bharosa khone ka saamna ho sakta hai. Hamle karobar ka kaam rok sakte hain, saakh (reputation) kharab kar sakte hain aur maali nuqsan ka sabab ban sakte hain. Schools aur hospitals bhi cyber waqiaat se mutasir ho sakte hain.
Security tools aur techniques

Security tools aur techniques computers aur networks ko online khatron se bachate hain. Yeh hackers ya nuqsan-deh (malicious) software ke liye zaroori maloomat tak pohanchna mushkil bana dete hain. In tools mein authentication systems (pehchan ki tasdeeq), firewalls aur antivirus programs shamil hain jo nuqsan-deh kaam check kar ke rokte hain. Inhein sahi tarah use karna zaati data mehfooz rakhta hai aur cyberattacks ka imkaan kam karta hai. Har computer user ko digital safety ke liye yeh tools samajhne aur use karne chahiyein.

blocks.alt: Beech mein 'Aap ka data' (taale ke saath), us se chaar dabbe jure: Firewall (nuqsandeh traffic roke), IDS (mashkook amal par khabar), Antivirus (virus aur malware hataye), 2FA aur biometrics (shanakht ki tasdeeq). Koi tarteeb nahi; sab mil kar kaam karte hain.
blocks.caption: Security ke tools mil kar data bachate hain (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.text: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)

Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) security ka aisa tareeqa hai jo account kholne se pehle do tarah ki tasdeeq (verification) mangta hai. Misal: password dalne ke baad user ko apni pehchan confirm karne ke liye phone ya email par ek code mil sakta hai. Yeh izafi qadam hackers ke liye andar ghusna bohat mushkil bana deta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen qadam upar se neeche: 1. Password (pehli tasdeeq); 2. Phone ya email par aaya code (doosri tasdeeq), phone ke nishan ke saath; phir 'Account khul gaya', dono sahi hon to hi rasai. Neeche: sirf chori ka password kafi nahi.
blocks.caption: Two-factor authentication (2FA) ke qadam (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.text: Biometric verification

Biometric verification pehchan ki tasdeeq ke liye jismani khoobiyan use karti hai, jaise fingerprints (ungliyon ke nishan), chehre ka scan ya awaz ka andaz. Biometrics accounts aur zaati data bachane ke liye hifazat ki mazboot tehein (layers) barhate hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Talaba doosre qadam (teacher ka diya hua code) ke saath account mein login ki naqal (simulation) karein ta ke samajh aaye ke 2FA kaise kaam karti hai.
Firewalls, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) aur antivirus tools ka istemal

Firewall computer aur internet ke darmiyan deewar (barrier) ka kaam karti hai: mehfooz data ko guzarne deti hai aur nuqsan-deh traffic ko rokti hai. Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) networks par mashkook (suspicious) sargarmi dekhte rehte hain aur users ko mumkin khatron se khabardar karte hain. Antivirus software files scan karta hai aur viruses ya malware ko nuqsan karne se pehle hata deta hai. Mil kar yeh tools cyberattacks ke khilaf taqatwar difa banate hain. Inhein baqaida use karna computers aur networks ko mehfooz aur theek chalta rakhta hai.
Data protection aur cryptography
Data protection ka matlab hai digital maloomat ko unauthorized access, zaya hone ya nuqsan se bachana. Yeh yaqeeni banata hai ke sirf sahi log hi data dekh ya use kar sakein.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Mehfooz storage aur transmission (data bhejna) unauthorized access aur breaches ko rokte hain.

Cryptography maloomat ko is tarah mehfooz karne ka ilm hai ke sirf authorized (ijazat wale) users hi use samajh sakein. Is ke do bunyadi concepts hain: encryption aur decryption. Encryption ek khaas key ki madad se parhne ke qabil data ko coded text mein badal deta hai, aur decryption zaroorat par use wapas asal shakal mein le aata hai. Misal: online message bhejte waqt encryption use har us shakhs ke liye na-qabil-e-faham bana deti hai jo use raaste mein pakarne (intercept) ki koshish kare. Is tarah bhejte waqt maloomat private rehti hai. Cryptography mehfooz websites, online banking aur messaging apps mein aam use hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Upar se neeche: HELLO (parhne ke qabil data, plaintext) se teer 'Encryption (key se)' KHOOR (coded matn, ciphertext) tak, phir teer 'Decryption (key se)' wapas HELLO tak. KHOOR se aik dotted teer 'raaste mein pakarne wale' tak jo sirf KHOOR dekhta hai.
blocks.caption: Key se encryption aur decryption (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh aik chhoti si misal hai: har harf ko alphabet mein teen qadam aage kar diya (H se K, E se H, L se O), yani yahan key 3 hai. Asal systems is se kahin lambi khufia keys aur mazboot riyazi tareeqe use karte hain. Asal baat wahi hai jo kitab kehti hai: key ke baghair raaste mein pakarne wala coded matn parh nahi sakta.
Data bhejne aur store karne ke mehfooz tareeqe

Data ko sirf computer par store karte waqt hi nahi balkay internet par bhejte waqt bhi bachana zaroori hai. Encrypted connections (jaise HTTPS) jaise mehfooz tareeqe bhejte waqt maloomat mehfooz rakhte hain. Cloud storage services bhi save ki gayi files tak unauthorized access rokne ke liye encryption use karti hain. Baqaida backups (data ki izafi copy) system kharab hone ya hamle se data zaya hone se bachate hain. Mehfooz storage aur transfer ke tareeqe apnane se zaroori data mehfooz aur bharosemand rehta hai.
Intrusions pakarna aur rokna

Intrusions (be-ijazat dakhal) pakarne aur rokne ka matlab hai computer ya network tak unauthorized access ko pehchanna aur rokna. Cyber intrusion tab hoti hai jab hackers kamzoriyon se faida utha kar data churate ya systems kharab karte hain. Monitoring tools aur security software ghair-mamooli sargarmi ko track karte hain jo hamle ki nishani ho sakti hai. Talaba seekhte hain ke jaldi pakarna bare nuqsan se bachata hai aur systems ko mehfooz chalta rakhta hai. Hoshyar rehna aur security ke intezamat update karte rehna intrusions se hifazat ke aham qadam hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Talaba namoone ke system logs (system ka record) ya screenshots dekh kar mashkook kaam dhoondein.
Vulnerabilities aur mashkook sargarmiyan pehchanna

Vulnerabilities software, hardware ya user ke rawaiye ki woh kamzoriyan hain jin se hackers faida utha sakte hain. Mashkook sargarmiyon mein system ka achanak slow hona, na-maloom programs ka chalna ya network ka ajeeb traffic shamil ho sakta hai. System logs baqaida check karna aur scanning tools use karna yeh khatre ke nishan dhoondne mein madad deta hai. Ghair-mamooli rawaiye ke patterns pehchan kar user jaldi qadam utha sakta hai. Kamzoriyan jaldi pehchan kar theek karna kamyab hamlon ka imkaan kam karta hai.
Troubleshooting aur bachao ke tareeqe apnana

Jab koi security masla mile to troubleshooting (masle ki jaanch) us ki wajah aur hal maloom karne mein madad deti hai. Bachao ke tareeqon (preventive measures) mein firewalls, antiviruses aur anti-malware install karna, software update karna, passwords badalna ya nuqsan-deh files hatana shamil hain. Kuch soorton mein backups se data wapas lana (restore) zaroori ho sakta hai. Masla aur us ke liye uthaye gaye qadam likh lena (document karna) use dobara hone se rokta hai.

blocks.prompt: Aap ko email aati hai: 'Aap ka bank account band hai. Yahan click kar ke 1 ghante mein apna PIN dalein.' Yeh kis qism ka hamla hai, aur aap ko kya karna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Phishing: yeh jaldi ka dabao dalti aur link ke zariye khufia tafseel mangti hai. Click ya jawab na dein; bank se us ke sarkari number ya app se rabta karein, email report kar ke delete karein. Banks kabhi email se PIN nahi mangte.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Khatre: virus, phishing, ransomware, spyware, DDoS; afraad aur idare dono mutasir.
Cryptography: key se encryption aur decryption; HTTPS, encrypted cloud storage, backups; vulnerabilities pehchanein, troubleshoot karein, bachao ke qadam uthayein.
